cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: A quantized LLM interprets outputs from a MobileNetV3-Small ONNX chest X-ray TB screener, including optional 2x2 occlusion-sensitivity zone weights. The LLM generates clinical explanations, triage recommendations, and patient education grounded in WHO TB guidelines via offline TF-IDF RAG. The LLM requires the vision model output to produce its interpretation — the integration is structurally load-bearing. A separate grounded Q&A path serves guideline questions without an image.

test_prompts.prompt: A chest X-ray screening result shows a TB probability of 78.3%. The patient is a 34-year-old male presenting with a persistent cough for 3 weeks. Explain the screening result to a community health worker, recommend next steps for triage, and provide a brief patient-friendly explanation.

A community health worker in a rural clinic asks: What are the key differences between a positive TB screening result and a confirmed TB diagnosis? How should each be managed at a primary health centre with limited diagnostic equipment? Include guidance on when to refer to a higher-level facility.
